headline: Rates up, bond prices down
sub: Why fixed-rate bonds lose value when rates rise

cards.label: Your bond
cards.body: Pays a fixed 3%. New bonds now pay 4%.

cards.label: The discount
cards.body: To sell yours, the price must drop, e.g. $1,000 to about $925 (SEC example).

cards.label: Maturity
cards.body: The longer the maturity, the bigger the price swing.

footer: Bond funds can lose value too
